entries.title: Hosea 11:1
segments: When Israel [was] a child, then I loved him and called My son out of Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 11:2
segments: As they called them, so they went from them. They sacrifice to the Baals, and burn incense to graven images.

entries.title: Hosea 11:3
segments: I also taught Ephraim to go; He took them on His arm. But they did not know that I healed them.

entries.title: Hosea 11:4
segments: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; and I was to them as those who take off the yoke on their jaws, and I gently give food to him.

entries.title: Hosea 11:5
segments: He shall not return to the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian [shall be] his king, because they refused to return.

entries.title: Hosea 11:6
segments: And the sword shall remain on his cities, and shall destroy his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

entries.title: Hosea 11:7
segments: And My people are bent on backsliding from Me. Though they called them to the Most High, none at all would exalt [Him].

entries.title: Hosea 11:8
segments: How shall I give you up, Ephraim? How shall I deliver you, Israel? How shall I make you like Admah? How shall I set you as Zeboim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassions are kindled together.

entries.title: Hosea 11:9
segments: I will not carry out the heat of My anger; I will not return to destroy Ephraim. For I [am] God and not man, the Holy One in your midst; and I will not enter into the city.

entries.title: Hosea 11:10
segments: They shall walk after the LORD; He shall roar like a lion. When He shall roar, then the sons shall tremble from the west.

entries.title: Hosea 11:11
segments: They shall tremble like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria. And I will place them in their houses, says the LORD.

entries.title: Hosea 11:12
segments: Ephraim [circles] around Me with lying, and the house of Israel with deceit. But Judah still rules with God, and is faithful with the saints.
